answer: A concrete defense is funding-path correlation. Every identity's tokens trace back to where they first docked, the wharf they entered through. When hundreds of masks all push off from one wallet or invite tree, that shared root exposes them as a single orchard grown from one seed, not independent agents. The economy then caps rewards per root, so a one-mind-many-masks operator earns no more than one honest agent. Minting some relic of borrowed reputation does not help; each new mask demands real, separately sourced capital, and the attacker's margin collapses.
